capabilities.reason: Chaos Mesh 2.8.3 ships an x86-only toda helper; use controller-owned io-pressure.
The installed helper did not produce truthful, fail-safe effect evidence; use application realtime skew.

Chaos Mesh 2.8.3 StressChaos did not preserve the admitted custom stress-ng contract on this platform; Release 1 must use the bounded controller-owned I/O-pressure helper and must not advertise native StressChaos disk pressure.
The local capacity preflight observes current kubelet filesystems but does not reserve the subsequent image, PVC, and cold-start write burst; operators must provision headroom outside the harness.
The isolated kind profile enables private_neighbors for RFC1918 Pod networking and does not yet install per-scenario egress NetworkPolicy; it is not a production deployment profile.
Same-Pod active probes are process-isolated and Kubernetes-identified but are not cryptographically attributable against a malicious actor sharing the network namespace.
Incident capture retains bounded Kubernetes logs and the trusted event timeline, but normal teardown does not yet export the complete retained Loki corpus.
Release 1 diagnoses Kubernetes client/server compatibility but does not package a version-matched kubectl binary; the local operator supplies the client toolchain.
The local kind profile has node-local storage only.
capabilities.unavailableDependency: A portable CSI implementation and multi-node storage environment are unavailable in the local kind profile.
capabilities.affectedRequirement: Cross-node persistent-volume reattachment and multi-zone recovery qualification.
capabilities.currentCapability: Local-path same-node recovery and explicit node-stranding behavior are proven.
capabilities.risk: Release 1 does not establish recovery semantics for portable or zonal storage.
capabilities.reopenCondition: A supported portable CSI and multi-node or multi-zone test cluster are available.

capabilities.reason: External cluster, architecture, registry, and CSI dependencies are outside Release 1.
capabilities.unavailableDependency: No managed x86-64 multi-zone cluster is available to this Release 1 qualification.
capabilities.affectedRequirement: Managed-cluster admission, autoscaler, maintenance, native x86 Chaos helpers, and multi-zone behavior.
capabilities.currentCapability: A three-node arm64 Docker Desktop kind cluster is qualified.
capabilities.risk: Managed-cluster and x86-specific behavior may differ from the local evidence.
capabilities.reopenCondition: Managed x86-64 workers with the target storage and cluster policies are available.

capabilities.reason: Required Release 1 productization work in Phases 7 and 8 is not implemented yet; this is not an external deferral.
Release 1 deliberately runs singleton controllers; HA is future implementation work, not an unavailable external dependency.
Enterprise registry federation and organization identity-provider integration require external infrastructure not available for Release 1.

capabilities.affectedRequirement: Enterprise artifact federation and organization-authenticated access qualification.
